inventory.notes: Observable by page code: with stealthMode the realm reports no debuggers (hasDebuggers() false) and does not enter debug mode, so Ion and the slow native-call path stay as on a non-debugged realm. stealthMode is a JS property of the Debugger object that Juggler sets, not a pref. The read of that property must happen before the no-GC region (it can run JS). The removal path runs during GC sweep, so it uses the cached invisibleDebuggee_ flag instead of reading the property. The guard that pops the debuggers_ entry on failure now checks appendedGlobalDebugger. The read of stealthMode can move to a helper in our file (one call); the step-1, step-4 and step-5 conditionals must stay in place because they guard the existing exit paths. Hunks: 1 addDebuggeeGlobal (stealthMode read, step 1, guard), 2 addDebuggeeGlobal (steps 4 and 5), 3 removeDebuggeeGlobal. Hookable changed to hard: only the stealthMode read (about 9 lines) can move; the step 1, guard, step 4, step 5 and erase conditionals (about 20 lines over 3 hunks) sit inside the no-GC section and the rollback guards, so they cannot move behind one call. Verified: Juggler sets stealthMode at juggler/content/Runtime.js:131 right after new Debugger() and before the addDebuggee calls (:413, :481), so the per-Debugger invisibleDebuggee_ flag is consistent (confirmed); invisibleDebuggee_ is written only at Debugger.cpp:5091 and read at :5245. removeDebuggeeGlobal is called from GC sweep at Debugger.cpp:4211 (FromSweep::Yes) and also from non-sweep paths at :4808 and :4830, so "runs during GC sweep" is true for one of three callers (confirmed, partial).

verifier.why: Scattered guards in the middle of a no-GC function cannot move behind one hook, so hookable is hard; added hunk map and verified the stealthMode and sweep claims.
